description: Only the tool pins in the Makefile. Cargo crates and GitHub Actions stay with Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml); every built-in manager is disabled so the two bots never overlap.
prBodyNotes: This PR bumps only the version line. The gate will fail on the first fetch until the committed hashes match: check out the branch, run `make tool-pin-hashes TOOL=<name>`, cross-check the printed hashes against the upstream release (checksum file or `gh attestation verify`), paste the block over the old `sha256_<name>_*` lines, and push. See "Tool pins" in CONTRIBUTING.md.

customManagers.description: Makefile `*_VERSION ?= x.y.z` lines annotated with `# renovate: datasource=... depName=... [extractVersion=...]` on the preceding line.
